query: By screening 39 metazoan genomes and 57 transcriptomes (Supplementary file 1), we found that the PTTH peptide is present in Drosophila and Tribolium but absent in the house spider Parasteatoda tepidariorum and the crustacean Parhyale hawaiensis, suggesting that PTTH is an insect innovation (Figure 2A,B, Figure 2—figure supplement 1A, Figure 2—source data 1).
